reference.title: AT+HTTPHEADER
reference.shortdesc: This command is used to set or query HTTP header information.

row.entry:
If succeed
If only the id parameter field is entered, and the current header information is empty:OKOtherwise, the previously entered HTTP header information will be returned: +HTTPHEADER:<id>,<length> <header> OKIf the formats of the id and the header are correct, the header information is set successfully: OK If failERROR
This command is used to set or query HTTP header information.
<id>Integer. The instance index returned by +HTTPCREATE. Range: 0~4. M5310-E/MN328-B range: 0~1.

<header>String. The header information to be configured. Value range of <header> in the MN316A module is 0-2048. Unit: byte. When <header> is empty and <encode_method> is 0, the module enters data mode. Data input is terminated when the input length reaches 2048 bytes, or when CTRL+Z is sent, or when a timeout of 20 seconds occurs.
<encode_method>Integer. Parsed as string or hexadecimal. When it is string, escape characters are supported. In MN316A data mode, only the value 0, which is also plain string is supported.

<len>Integer. Specify the length of input data in data mode. Range: 0~2048. When the length is entered, the module enters data mode. <header> and <encode_method> may be omitted or set to an invalid value. When <len> is set to 0, data input is terminated when the input length reaches 2048 bytes, or when CTRL+Z is sent, or when a timeout of 20 seconds occurs; When <len> is set to a value greater than 0, data input is terminated when the specified length is reached or when a timeout of 20 seconds occurs. MN316A does not support this parameter.
<length> Return the length of the entered header.

Create instances AT+HTTPHEADER=0,"User-Agent: Unkown
Content-Type: application/text
" OK AT+HTTPHEADER=0,"Connection: close
" /*Add a header field. */ OK AT+HTTPHEADER=0 /*Display the currently entered header. */ +HTTPHEADER:0,71 /*The entered header length is 71 bytes. The content is as follows: */ User-Agent: Unkown Content-Type: application/text Connection: close OK AT+HTTPHEADER=0,"" /*Clear the entered header. */ OK AT+HTTPHEADER=0 /*The header is empty now, and OK is returned directly. */ OK

ul.li: The HTTP protocol requires that header fields be separated by \r\n;
When the entered header field is empty, the previously entered header will be cleared. Otherwise, the newly entered header will be appended after the previous one.
